title: Find the Work Done by the Father
text: The work done by the father is $$W=\tau\theta,$$ where $$\tau=Fr$$ is the torque he applies and $$\theta$$ is the angular displacement in radians.

title: Relate Work Done to Rotational Kinetic Energy
text: According to the work-energy principle, the work done by the father equals the change in rotational kinetic energy: $$W=KE, $$ so $$\tau\theta=185\,\text{J}.$$ Solve for $$\theta$$ to three decimal places (in $$\text{rad})$$.

title: Convert Angular Displacement to Number of Revolutions
text: The number of revolutions is $$N=\frac{\theta}{2\pi}.$$ What is $$N$$?
